facts.activity_file: monitoring dust, fume and gas exposure

assets.label: hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel
assets.service: diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: preventive action - alarm setpoint on V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure on V-4110 and PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically monitoring dust, fume and gas exposure. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 8 November 2010 a corrective action on V-4110 and PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
